I wrote `component.html` in the folder, but I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked. The `#component` element is 1280px wide and holds the whole sign-in screen. It has the seven content items worded exactly as you gave them, in static HTML and CSS with no JavaScript.

I followed `DESIGN.md` and `tokens.css`:
- **Page:** white paper, one column, 48px above the content, 32px side padding.
- **Card:** 400px wide, 32px padding, 1px ink-tint border, 16px radius.
- **Heading:** Unbounded Light in capitals, set with CSS so the source text stays "Sign in to Harbor".
- **Fields:** 44px tall, labels in the 12px spaced-caps style, 24px apart, 2px accent focus ring.
- **Buttons:** both are 44px pills. "Sign In" is ink-filled and "Continue with SSO" has a 1.5px ink outline.
- **Link and checkbox:** "Forgot Password?" is a plain underlined link, and both it and the checkbox row have 44px touch targets.
- **Colour and dusk theme:** all colours, sizes and spacing come from tokens. I inlined the subset of `tokens.css` the screen uses, plus the dusk theme values.

The fonts are the tokens' font stacks, and the folder has no font files. Unbounded and Archivo will fall back to system fonts unless they're installed.
